name: Lobster
description: Lobster workflow tool plugin for typed pipelines and resumable approvals.
recommendedPrompts: Help me get Lobster ready for a repeatable workflow. Ask what task I want to automate, check whether the plugin and tool are available in a supported non-sandboxed context, and identify the required existing tools. Do not install anything or relax sandbox policy automatically.

Help me design a small Lobster workflow for a task I choose. Separate read-only preparation from external effects, add explicit approval or input checkpoints, and explain how resuming avoids rerunning completed steps. Show the workflow and its tool requirements before running it; do not send, post, delete, or schedule anything.
